propositions: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote fails with exit 128 when host injects safe.bareRepository=explicit policy via GIT_CONFIG_* environment variables
git -C <bare.git> cat-file and rev-parse commands are refused under safe.bareRepository=explicit security policy, preventing bare-repo fixture verification even though the push succeeds

_git() helper in test_ref_lock.py uses git -C against bare fixtures, violating the portability contract established by test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py and prior art in _git_upkeep.py
explicit --git-dir naming is permitted under safe.bareRepository=explicit and matches established pattern for bare-repo inspection in _git_upkeep and test_concurrency_regression
fix requires routing bare-repo git invocations through --git-dir instead of -C while preserving -C for work-tree repos
